Hi Carly —

Thanks for signing up to try Redwood Hosted API. I saw your team (FastMarket) requested an evaluation; I’m Nikhil on the PLG SDR team and I’ll help get a short walkthrough scheduled and provision sandbox access.

Quick Qs so we can pick one slot that works best:
- Do you prefer 30 or 45 minutes for the walkthrough? (45 recommended if you want a short technical demo + Q&A)
- Which timezone are you in? I can propose windows in ET/UTC as needed.

For options today/tomorrow I have the following open (EDT):
- Today 2:00–2:45 PM EDT (30/45)
- Tomorrow 10:30–11:15 AM EDT

If those don’t work, send a couple times that do and I’ll consolidate. I’ll include Mina from our demo ops team for provisioning.

Next steps: confirm preferred length & a time and I’ll send a calendar invite + sandbox prep doc.

Best,

Thanks — we’re excited to try this. A couple notes:

- I think 45 minutes would be better for us.

Available windows (PDT):
- Today 11:00–11:45 AM PDT
- Tomorrow 9:00–9:45 AM PDT
